pages.overview_desc: Live status, fuel, faults, and quick links to your routes, scorecard, and alerts.
pages.cost_per_mile_desc: Operating cost per mile by vehicle, calculated from your fuel entries and odometer readings. Compare to fleet average to spot outliers.
pages.role_perms_desc_short: Decide what each role is allowed to see and do. Changes take effect on the next page load for active users.
pages.role_perms_desc_long: Decide what each role is allowed to see and do. Toggle a permission to change it for everyone in that role; per-company overrides are also supported.
pages.coaching_desc_short: Automatic coaching assignments triggered by safety scorecards or unsafe events.
pages.coaching_desc_long: Automatic coaching assignments triggered by safety scorecards or unsafe events. Configure rules and topics, then watch assignments accrue and get acknowledged.
pages.coaching_desc_default: Automatic coaching assignments triggered by safety scorecards or unsafe events. Drivers acknowledge in Telegram or here.
pages.audit_log_desc: Every change to your account — who did what and when. Useful for compliance and tracing accidental edits.
pages.cameras_desc_short: Health checks for in-cab dashcams. Diagnose obstructed lenses, lost connections, and dirty cameras at a glance.
pages.cameras_desc_long: Health checks for in-cab dashcams. Diagnose obstructed lenses, lost connections, and dirty cameras — click a row for the latest snapshot.
pages.fuel_costs_desc: Log fuel purchases and track per-vehicle spend over time. Combined with odometer readings this powers the Cost-per-Mile report.
pages.scorecard_rules_desc: Tune how driver scores are calculated — adjust point values and caps for each behaviour. Changes apply at the next evaluation cycle.
pages.routes_desc: Replay any vehicle's trip on a map. Pick a truck and date — we'll plot the route colored by speed and surface stops along the way.
pages.companies_desc: Sub-companies inside your account — each with its own Samsara API key. Use companies to scope reporting and alerts to a single division or region.
pages.scheduled_reports_desc: Schedule a recurring report delivery via Telegram and/or email. Pick the report type, frequency, hour, time zone, and delivery channel(s) — you can change or stop it any time.
pages.settings_desc_short: Account-wide settings: timezone, Telegram bot, working hours, and feature flags.
pages.settings_desc_long: Account-wide settings that affect everyone on this account. For your own display name, language, timezone override, and Working Hours override, open My Profile from the user menu.
pages.billing_desc_short: Manage your plan, monitor AI usage, and review billing history.
pages.billing_desc_long: Manage your plan, monitor AI usage, and review billing history. Stripe customers can update card details and download invoices in the customer portal.
pages.invites_desc: Generate one-time links to add new users. Choose the role first — drivers can also be pre-bound to a truck number.
pages.maintenance_desc: Scheduled service tasks across all vehicles — inspections, oil changes, tire rotations and more. Click a row to update status.
pages.inspections_desc: Driver pre-trip inspections — review submitted PTIs, approve or flag defects for service.
pages.template_editor_desc: Edit the PTI checklist for trucks and trailers. Edits apply to the NEXT inspection spawned; in-flight inspections keep their snapshot.
pages.team_desc: Manage team members, assign roles, set each person's data scope (companies + vehicles), and link Telegram drivers to their Samsara records.
pages.work_hours_desc_short: Define active hours per role — alerts pause outside these windows so the team isn't paged off-shift.
pages.work_hours_desc_long: Define active hours per role — alerts pause outside these windows so the team isn't paged off-shift. Schedules use the account time zone.
pages.payroll_desc_short: Driver pay per period — earnings from delivered loads, extra pay (layover / TONU), and safety bonuses.
pages.payroll_desc_long: Driver pay per period: earnings from delivered loads, extra pay (layover, TONU, detention), and safety bonuses — one statement per driver. Drivers can self-serve their paystubs in Telegram or the mobile mini-app.
pages.reports_desc: Download or schedule any of the standard fleet reports — faults, fuel, efficiency, vehicle health.
pages.knowledge_desc: Documentation, guides, and tips for getting the most out of your fleet platform.
pages.chat_desc: Ask anything about your fleet, drivers, vehicles, or operations — in plain English.
pages.live_map_desc: Real-time vehicle locations and status. Filter by company or status; click a marker for details.
pages.geofences_desc: Draw and manage geofences that trigger alerts on entry, exit, or extended dwell.
pages.risk_summary_desc: Per-driver risk profile with safety incidents, coaching history, and trend over the chosen window.

cost_reports.title: Cost Reports
cost_reports.description: Spend per vehicle, vendor, task type, and over time — drives quarterly review and vendor negotiation.
cost_reports.export_csv_title: Download all four reports as one CSV
cost_reports.empty_title: No cost data in this window
cost_reports.empty_desc: Cost Reports aggregate completed work orders with a service date. Add invoice details to a work order to start populating spend.
cost_reports.spend_by_vehicle_hint: Click a bar to see that truck's work orders.
cost_reports.spend_by_task_type_hint: Click a slice to see work orders of that type.
cost_reports.top_vendors_hint: Click a row to see all work orders with that vendor.
cost_reports.monthly_trend_hint: Spend over time — slope shows whether the fleet is trending up or down.

work_orders_page.list_description: Shop visits, parts, invoices, and costs — closes maintenance tasks and feeds cost reports.
work_orders_page.row_click_hint: Click a row to view details, parts, attachments, and linked maintenance tasks.
work_orders_page.empty_desc: Create one when a truck visits the shop — log vendor, costs, parts, and link it to the maintenance tasks it closes.
work_orders_page.form_desc_new: Log a shop visit, parts used, and invoice details.
work_orders_page.form_desc_edit: Edit visit details, parts, attachments, and linked maintenance tasks.
work_orders_page.attachments_unlock_desc: Save the work order first to get an id — then you can attach invoices and photos here.
work_orders_page.ph_notes: Anything else worth recording — sublet work, warranty claims, follow-ups…
work_orders_page.no_parts: No parts added. Click "Add part" to log line items.
work_orders_page.toast_save_first: Save the work order first, then attach files.
work_orders_page.no_attachments: No attachments yet. Upload an invoice PDF or shop photo.
work_orders_page.save_first_hint: Save the draft first; you can add attachments and link maintenance tasks on the edit screen.

forum_routing.section_desc: Connect a Telegram forum group so the bot can post each alert to its own topic. Personal DMs are independent — each user sets their own preferences under Avatar → My Notifications.
forum_routing.setup_step_1: Create a Telegram group with the bot as an admin (with the 'Manage Topics' permission).
forum_routing.setup_step_2: Enable Topics on the group (Group Settings → Topics → toggle on).
forum_routing.setup_step_3: Send /setupforum inside the group — the bot will create the 11 alert topics automatically.
forum_routing.topic_status_inactive: Disabled — alerts of this type fall back to DM
forum_routing.btn_disconnect_confirm: Are you sure? Group routing will stop — users only get alerts via their personal DM preferences.
forum_routing.toast_disconnected: Forum routing disconnected — alerts revert to DMs.
forum_routing.ai_per_type_desc: Choose which alert types include the bot's AI diagnosis when posted to the group's topics. Per-user DM fallbacks still respect each subscriber's personal AI toggle.
forum_routing.ai_status_on: AI Analysis ON — included in group posts
forum_routing.ai_status_off: AI Analysis OFF — group posts use alert text only

knowledge.empty_desc_can_create: Add tips, guides and SOPs for your team — text, video, PDF or links are all supported.

knowledge.video_hint: Paste a YouTube, Vimeo, or Loom link. Host the video there first — readers get captions and smooth playback on mobile that a direct upload can't match.

storage.page_desc: Where your company's documents and captures are saved — driver records, work-order invoices, dashcam frames, parking maps. Bring your own Google Drive to keep these bytes in your account and cut platform storage costs.

storage.disconnect_success: Google Drive disconnected — back on local storage.

status.stuck_hint: Open the Files panel below to retry stuck uploads

settings.title: Backend settings
settings.drive_help: Connect your Drive so we can save files into a folder you own. 15 GB free with a standard Google account.

settings.backend_gdrive_desc: Uploads stream straight to your Drive. Slower per upload, no local cache.
settings.backend_hybrid_desc: Fast disk write, then background sync to Drive. Best of both — needs Drive connected.
